sites.reason: live reply: settleBatch marks the batch replied before the send, and a failed send keeps the answer as a draft
owner approval: the release is recorded durably at the start of the approved body, and a release that cannot be written stops the body
owner's own run: the release is recorded in the before-tool gate, before the tool body runs
worker handoff: the batch has durable custody before notify, a failed batch is re-queued, and the terminal settle is idempotent in the event store
owner-session notice: the delivery id is the idempotency key, and a notice the transcript already holds is dropped, not sent again
orchestrator notice: a failed delivery is retried by the next pass, and the durable record already holds the message
usage receipt keyed by reportId: only a pending receipt is retried, by the next pass
owner push: the push's key is written to the channel journal before the send (a crash loses a push rather than sending it twice), and a failed send is warned, not retried

the part transport: its callers record the reply first (settleDraft claims the draft through claimThenEffect; deliverReply marks the batch replied before it sends); a draft send journals each accepted part before the next, and a live reply keeps the accepted parts with the draft it leaves on failure
control reply: Pi's best-effort answer to an owner control word, sent after the control word is handled; it has no record of its own, and a failed send is warned, not retried
owner-session note: the delivery id is the parent ledger's idempotency key, and the ledger accepts the note canonically before it is consumed, so an accepted note is not delivered again
port adapter of the host-event session: its root delivery is guarded and receipted by the session controller, and the delivery id is the parent ledger's idempotency key
port adapter of routine intake: announce claims the notice (claimThenEffect) before it calls deliver, and isDelivered reads the same delivery id

port adapter of the plan executor: it skips a delivery the parent ledger holds (isDelivered) and a delivery in flight in this process (delivering); the delivery id is the parent ledger's idempotency key
